name: resolveai-root
description: ResolveAI - From customer issue to verified resolution — autonomously.

scripts.dev: node -e 'import("child_process").then(({ spawn }) => { const b = spawn("npm", ["run", "dev"], { cwd: "backend", stdio: "inherit", shell: true }); const f = spawn("npm", ["run", "dev"], { cwd: "frontend", stdio: "inherit", shell: true }); process.on("SIGINT", () => { b.kill(); f.kill(); process.exit(); }); });'
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build && rm -rf dist && cp -r frontend/dist dist
